column1: # control-rows.tsv -- rows for mkctl_regev.py (tools-agent, fill ef-r23-regev, 2026-11-18).
# One row = one target definition = TWO controls: <control> (NEGATIVE: the foreign read the reader replaces; must
# pass unsealed and fail exactly once sealed) and <control>Reader (POSITIVE: the same statement through the
# published reader; must pass sealed and unsealed).
# Columns (TAB-separated; "-" = empty; the two-character sequence \n inside a field is a newline):
#   target    full name of the sealed target definition (must appear as `spelling` in a seal record's rows)
#   owner     dotted module of the target (checked against the record's `home` for that row)
#   control   Lean theorem name of the negative (the positive is <control>Reader); unique over the file
#   open      `open ... in` prefix (without the trailing newline), or -
#   reader    reader application; both controls state `type_of% (<reader>)`
#   neg       proof of the negative (rfl: defeq through the target's body; `unfold`/`simp [f]` would NOT fail
#             under a seal, because equation lemmas ignore irreducibility)
#   pos       proof of the positive, or - for `<reader>` itself
# Rows are grouped by series; add series-3 rows (PublicKey.Regev) at the end.
